FTP2P - dual-pane FTP client for MS-DOS

Features:
- dual-pane interface
- FTP upload/download support
- basic file operations
- utf8 support
- internal viewer

Limitations:
- no long filename (LFN) support
- no recursive directory copy
- up to 3000 entries per panel

See project page for more information:
https://github.com/radozd/ftp2p
